name: Espresso
steps: Grind the beans and distribute them evenly in the basket.
Tamp level and firm.
Pull a double shot, about 36 g in 25 to 30 seconds.

name: Americano
steps: Pour the hot water into the cup.
Pull a double shot over it, about 36 g in 25 to 30 seconds.

name: Cappuccino
steps: Pull a double shot, about 36 g in 25 to 30 seconds.
Steam the milk to a thick, airy foam.
Pour it over the espresso, finishing with a cap of foam.

name: Latte
steps: Pull a double shot, about 36 g in 25 to 30 seconds.
Steam the milk with only a little foam.
Pour it into the espresso.

name: Flat white
steps: Pull a double shot, about 36 g in 25 to 30 seconds.
Steam the milk to a thin, glossy microfoam.
Pour it into the espresso in a steady stream.

name: Cortado
steps: Pull a double shot, about 36 g in 25 to 30 seconds.
Warm the milk with almost no foam.
Add it to the espresso in about equal measure.

name: Mocha
steps: Put the chocolate sauce in the cup.
Pull a double shot over it, about 36 g in 25 to 30 seconds. Stir to combine.
Steam the milk and pour it in.

name: Pour over (V60)
steps: Rinse the paper filter with hot water and discard the water.
Add the ground coffee and pour about 40 ml of water to bloom for 30 seconds.
Pour the rest in slow circles, finishing by about 1:45.
Let it drain; total time is around 3 minutes.

name: French press
steps: Add the ground coffee and all the water.
Steep for 4 minutes.
Break the crust, skim the foam, then press the plunger down slowly.
Pour it all out so it does not keep brewing.

name: Aeropress
steps: Rinse the paper filter and set the Aeropress on a cup.
Add the ground coffee and all the water, then stir.
Fit the plunger to hold a seal and steep for 2 minutes.
Stir once more and press gently for about 30 seconds.

name: Moka pot
steps: Fill the base with just-boiled water up to the valve.
Fill the basket with ground coffee and level it without tamping.
Assemble the pot and set it over medium heat with the lid open.
Take it off the heat as soon as the coffee starts to sputter.

name: Cold brew
steps: Stir the ground coffee into room-temperature water.
Cover and steep in the fridge for 12 to 18 hours.
Strain through a paper filter.
Dilute the concentrate about one to one with water or milk to serve.
